title: Ancient discovery from time of Jesus emerges near Jerusalem's Temple Mount
summary: Hebrew University archaeologists excavated a well-preserved ritual bathing complex, about 2,000 years old, in the Ophel just south of the Temple Mount. It likely served Jewish pilgrims purifying themselves before entering the Second Temple.

title: Massive 2,000-year-old discovery from time of Jesus emerges remarkably intact
summary: A Second Temple–period ritual bath (mikveh) weighing 25 tons was lifted intact by crane in Kiryat Gat, Israel, to protect it from construction, the Israel Antiquities Authority said.

title: Site where Jesus was crucified and buried reveals new evidence that backs biblical account
summary: Excavations beneath the Church of the Holy Sepulchre led by Francesca Stasolla found ancient seeds and pollen. The article says this is consistent with John 19:41's garden near the crucifixion site.

title: Shroud of Turin wasn't laid on Jesus' body, but rather a sculpture, modeling study suggests
summary: A 3-D modeling study in the journal Archaeometry compared cloth draped over a human body with cloth laid over a low-relief carving. It found the Shroud's image fits a low relief better, which would point to an artwork.

title: Shroud of Turin: Medieval bas-relief hypothesis challenged on scientific grounds
summary: Researchers published a reply in Archaeometry arguing that the low-relief study overlooked the image's physical and chemical features and the presence of real blood.

title: DNA on the Shroud of Turin reveals centuries of hidden history
summary: A DNA study found a mix of human, plant, animal and microbial traces built up through centuries of handling and travel. The authors say the results do not settle the Shroud's age or authenticity.

title: Ancient olive pits and lentils discovered at biblical Shiloh site by experts
summary: Excavators at Tel Shiloh, where the Bible says the Ark was once kept, found jars holding hundreds of burned olive pits and lentils. Radiocarbon dates were still pending.
